item.title: Backup Exclude
item.description:
Data Type: backup_exclude
Python Parser: RegSnapExclude

Description

Each row is a path configured for exclusion from Volume Shadow Copy or backup processing, with exclusion type, path, key LastWrite time, owner, and permissions. Use it to identify data omitted from recovery sources or suspicious attempts to reduce backup coverage. The setting records configuration intent and does not prove that a backup ran or exclusion occurred.

item.title: Getthis
item.description:
Data Type: getthis
Python Parser: GetThis

Description

Each row describes a file selected by ORC GetThis, with source path, volume and snapshot, NTFS identifiers and timestamps, size, hashes, match reason, and YARA result where available. Use it to connect collected content to its original filesystem context. Selection reflects collection rules rather than a complete inventory, and collection time is distinct from file timestamps.

item.title: I30 info
item.description:
Data Type: i30info
Python Parser: I30Info

Description

Each row represents a current or carved NTFS directory-index entry, with name, reconstructed path, file and parent record identifiers, timestamps, size, attributes, volume, and snapshot. Use it to recover directory membership and possible deleted-name remnants. Carved records and embedded timestamps require corroboration, and a directory entry alone does not prove user interaction.

Timeline

Additional Description file_size

record_number Int record/index part of the File Reference Number (FRN)
FRN Extension

parent_record_number Int record/index part of the File Reference Number (FRN)

snapshot_id Python

item.title: Mass Storage
item.description:
Data Type: mass_storage

Description

Each row consolidates registry evidence for a mass-storage device, with device and instance identifiers, serial or volume labels, drive mapping, user context, and setup or arrival/removal times where available. Use it to correlate removable media across registry sources and file activity. Timestamps have source-specific meanings and should be corroborated before inferring an exact physical connection.

item.title: Merge File
item.description:
Data Type: merge_file
Python Parser: Merge

Description

Each row is the complete text of one multiline input artifact after its lines are concatenated for downstream parsing or language-model analysis. It preserves content but adds no independent event semantics, timestamps, or provenance beyond the source file. Interpret any claims using the originating artifact and collection context.

Timeline

This plugin does not contains timestamped data and cannot be used to create a timeline

Fields

Output Name Data Type Description

Each row represents an NTFS Master File Table record exported by ORC, with path, file and parent identifiers, standard and filename timestamps, attributes, size, hashes, and executable metadata. item.title: Recycle Bin
item.description:
Data Type: recycle_bin
Python Parser: RecycleBin

Description

Each row represents Recycle Bin metadata for a deleted item, with original path, item size, deletion time, and format header. Use it to place a file or directory in a deletion timeline and correlate its former location with filesystem records. It does not identify the actor or prove permanent deletion, and metadata may be absent after cleanup or bypassing the Recycle Bin.

Timeline

Timeline Field Data Field
Description path
Additional Description size

Fields

Output Name Data Type Description
path String original full path of the deleted file before it was sent to the Recycle Bin
size Int size, in bytes, of the original file that was deleted
header String INFO2 file version identifier (1 = Vista/7, 2 = Windows 10+)
uninstall_date DateTime timestamp when the file was removed (deleted) and placed in the Recycle Bin

item.title: Shellbags
item.description:
Data Type: shellbags
Python Parser: RegShellBag

Description

Each row reconstructs a folder or item recorded in a user’s Shellbag hierarchy, with browsed path, item type and name, embedded timestamps, and registry provenance. Use it to infer Explorer awareness of folders, including removable or network locations, and correlate paths with other user artifacts. Times belong to item or Registry structures rather than a guaranteed visit event; local DOS or FAT times are normalized with the matching SYSTEM hive.

item.title: Usn Info
item.description:
Data Type: usninfo
Python Parser: USNInfo

Description

Each row is an NTFS USN Change Journal record, with file and parent identifiers, path, timestamp, reason flags, attributes, volume, and snapshot context. Use it to reconstruct sequences of filesystem changes and correlate renamed or deleted objects. Reason flags describe recorded changes rather than user intent, multiple changes can be combined, and journal retention is finite.
